{{Navbar-Global Gas Infrastructure Tracker}}
'''Kinder Morgan Louisiana Pipeline''' is an operating natural gas pipeline in the United States.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline runs from Sabine Pass LNG Terminal, Cameron Parish, Louisiana to Columbia Gulf Transmission interconnect, Evangeline Parish, Louisiana.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.naturalgasintel.com/?p=60678|title=naturalgasintel.com|website=naturalgasintel.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Project Details==
===Main Line===
*'''Owner: '''Kinder Morgan Louisiana Pipeline LLC
*'''Capacity: '''2,130 MMcf/d<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.naturalgasintel.com/?p=60678|title=naturalgasintel.com|website=naturalgasintel.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Length: '''132 mi<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.naturalgasintel.com/?p=60678|title=naturalgasintel.com|website=naturalgasintel.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Diameter: '''24, 42 in<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.naturalgasintel.com/?p=60678|title=naturalgasintel.com|website=naturalgasintel.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Status: '''Operating<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Start year: '''2009<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
